Initial commit: BHMI ilmiy jurnal boshqaruv tizimi

- Laravel 11 + React 18 + TypeScript + Inertia.js stack
- Menu, About, JournalIssue, Article CRUD funksiyalari
- Admin middleware va rol asosida kirish nazorati
- Fayl yuklash \(PDF/DOC\) va slug avtomatik generatsiya
- Responsive UI: Tailwind CSS + Radix UI komponentlari

Tuzatilgan xatolar:
- 404 xatosi: articleview/archiveview firstOrFail\(\) bilan
- removeFile: bo'sh string o'rniga null yozish
- handleRemoveFile: post\(\) o'rniga put\(\) HTTP metodi
- renderError\("type"\) -> renderError\("journal_issue_id"\)
- Ikkilangan renderError\("file_url"\) olib tashlandi
- colSpan={7} -> to'g'ri ustun soni \(4/5\)
- Fayl validatsiyasi: mimes va max qoidalari qo'shildi
- Ortiqcha touch\(\) chaqiruvlari olib tashlandi
- Imlo xatosi: Muvofaqqiyatli -> Muvaffaqiyatli

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<'EOF'
feat: SEO va Performance optimizatsiyasi

Performance:
- LCP rasm \(page.webp\): fetchpriority="high", loading="eager", width/height
- Barcha rasmlarga width/height atributlari qo'shildi \(CLS oldini olish\)
- Google Fonts: faqat kerakli og'irliklar yuklandi \(400,600,700,800\)
- app.blade.php: LCP rasm preload, theme-color meta qo'shildi
- vite.config.js: manualChunks bilan vendor bundle splitting
  \(react, inertia, tinymce, utils alohida chunklarga ajratildi\)
- iframe elementlariga loading="lazy" qo'shildi
- Fayl mavjudligini tekshirib iframe ko'rsatiladi

SEO:
- MainLayout: meta description, Open Graph, Twitter Card, canonical URL
- head-key atributlari — sahifalar orasida navigatsiyada deduplication
- Har bir sahifaga unikal meta description qo'shildi
- stripHtml\(\) utility — HTML kontentdan description olish
- Heading ierarxiyasi tuzatildi:
  h1 faqat sahifaning asosiy sarlavhasi \(bitta h1\)
  Main, Right, Footer, ArchiveView da h1 -> h2
- aria-label barcha icon tugmalariga qo'shildi
- Navigatsiyaga <header> va aria-label semantik teglari
- Pagination tugmalariga aria-label va aria-current qo'shildi
- Tashqi havolalarga rel="noopener noreferrer"
- Telefon va email havolalari tel: va mailto: bilan

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
